pages.en:
特高課
Michel K. Bereza, Rus. Emig.
194 Broadway, Shanghai.
December 14th, 1944.
Tel - 6341 949.
No.
Date 30-12-44

To the Commissioner
of the Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Sir,
I beg to inform you that I, M.K.Bereza, am the proprietor of the Bar Budapest at 194 Broadway Road. My illegal wife, Eve L.Feld-Bereza, Russian Jew, about two months ago, being under the influence of the Soviet elements and their propaganda, started to make me troubles and scandals, insulting me purposely by calling me as White Army bandit, because I was a soldier of the Russian White Army and a volunteer of the S.V.C. Probably she acted in such a manner under the influence of her brother, Abraham Feld, Soviet subject, Jew, furrier by profession, residing in Dairen, with whom she is keeping a close contact. Lately, on December 12th, 1944, she received a telegram from him informing her of his soon arrival at Shanghai. At the same time, my illegal wife declares that she does not want to live with a White Russian and intends to find a Jew (Soviet) instead of myself.
Though the Bar and the house are bought with my own money received as bonus (remuniration) for my eight years' service in S.V.C., yet she demands of transferring to her of all this property to her.
On the 11th of December, 1944, Mrs.Eve Feld, stole my gray woollen suit, costing about C.R.3.831.00 and pawned it. She openly said that this amount of money she had used as remuniration to the detective, Sub-Inspector Drozdoff, who promised her to help in evicting me from the house and depriving me of my rights for the Bar and the house (Sub-Inspector Drozdoff had been several times previously pushed such affairs with others successfully). The witnesses of what she said above are Mr.Milichenko, 194 Broadway Road, and Mr.G.A.Pickard, 936 East Seward Road, apt.31. In accordance with the words of Mrs.Feld, Mr.Drozdoff, Sub-Inspector, is a good friend of Jews and would always help her, being a very useful servant of them.
On Dec.12th, 1944, Sub-Inspector Drozdoff came to the place of my service at 4 p.m.where I serve as Russia watchman No. 88, and requested me to come to the Hongkew Police Station at 10 a.m.next morning, for the settling of the case between my illegal wife and myself. Having arrived at the appointed hour to the Police Station, I submitted a complaint in the written form regarding my stolen suit by Mrs. Feld. This complaint was not accepted, and besides that, in presence of the Chinese detective, Sub-Inspector Drozdoff said that I should be arrested and handcuffed, in case, I should contradict and make troubles with Mrs. Feld, and further more, there would be commenced a criminal prosecution against me. It is strange to note that at

治安處 Bereza
pages.zh:
特高课
米歇尔·K·别列扎，俄国侨民。
上海百老汇路194号。
1944年12月14日。
电话 - 6341 949。
编号。
日期 1944年12月30日

致
上海公共租界工部局警务处总监。

尊敬的先生：
谨此告知，我，M.K.别列扎，系百老汇路194号“布达佩斯酒吧”的业主。我的非法妻子，犹太裔俄国人伊芙·L·费尔德-别列扎（Eve L.Feld-Bereza），约在两个月前，受苏联分子及其宣传的影响，开始给我制造麻烦和丑闻，故意侮辱我，称我为白匪军强盗，因为我曾是俄罗斯白军士兵及上海志愿队（S.V.C.）的志愿者。她如此行事，可能是受其兄亚伯拉罕·费尔德（Abraham Feld）的影响。亚伯拉罕·费尔德系苏联籍犹太人，职业为皮货商，居住于大连，她与其保持密切联系。最近，在1944年12月12日，她收到来自其兄的电报，通知他即将抵达上海。同时，我的非法妻子宣称，她不愿与一名白俄共同生活，并打算找一名犹太人（苏联人）来取代我。
尽管该酒吧和房屋是用我在上海志愿队（S.V.C.）服役八年所得的奖金（报酬）购买的，但她仍要求将所有这些财产转让给她。
1944年12月11日，费尔德太太偷走了我价值约中储券3,831.00元的灰色毛料西装，并将其典当。她公开声称，这笔钱已用作给侦探副巡官德罗兹多夫（Drozdoff）的报酬，后者承诺帮助将我逐出房屋，并剥夺我对酒吧和房屋的权利（副巡官德罗兹多夫此前曾多次成功处理此类事务）。上述言论的见证人为百老汇路194号的米利琴科先生（Mr.Milichenko）和西华德东路936号31室的G.A.皮卡德先生（Mr.G.A.Pickard）。据费尔德太太所言，副巡官德罗兹多夫先生是犹太人的好朋友，总是帮助他们，是他们非常有用的仆人。
1944年12月12日下午4时，副巡官德罗兹多夫来到我任职的地方，我在此担任第88号俄国更夫，他要求我于次日上午10时前往虹口警署，以解决我与非法妻子之间的案件。当我按约定时间到达警署时，我就费尔德太太盗窃我西装一事提交了书面投诉。该投诉未被受理，此外，在华籍侦探在场的情况下，副巡官德罗兹多夫称，如果我反驳并与费尔德太太制造麻烦，我将被逮捕并戴上手铐，并且还将对我提起刑事诉讼。奇怪的是，在

治安处 别列扎

that time there was nothing touched as to my complaint.
Yesterday, on Dec. 13th h, 1944, I received a letter
from Sub-Inspector Drozdoff, who ordered me to come to the
Honkew Police Station at 10 a.m.
Dear Sir, I have the honour to beg you respectfully
of the following:-
I. To protect me from the continues, provocative and
humiliating scandals on the side of Mrs. Feld, my ex-illegal
wife/ with whom I have not been living actually during the
last two months, though under the same roof, but in separate
rooms), which are created with the purpose of tarnishing my
good name and making up of the false criminal case against
me, as if she was attacked by me, beaten and insulted, and
for this purpose she had already obtained, by the advice of
Sub-Inspector Drozdoff, a medical certificate which does not
which does not accord with the reality.
II. To hand over this case to another detective, as Mr.
Drozdoff, according to the words of my ex-illegal wife, Mrs.
Feld, is materially interested in winning this case in favour
of her, i.e.
III. To help me in returning my stolen suit of clothes.
IV. To save me from the troubles and threats of Sub-In-
spector Drozdoff to sign any paper defaming my good name (from
the words of Mrs. Feld) and to put me down.
I deem it a favour, Your Excellency, to inform you that
I have taken the measures through my Lawyer, Mr. Shendrikoff,
of depriving her of the rights for managing of my property.
Trusting that you will consider my application favourably,
I remain, Your Excellency,

Yours very obediently,
M. M. Berezov
V. V. Berezov, watchman 85.

倍利后
8 8
pages.zh:
- 2 -
当时，对我的投诉只字未提。
昨天，即1944年12月13日，我收到副巡官德罗兹多夫的来信，命令我于上午10时前往虹口警署。
尊敬的先生，谨此恭敬地请求如下事项：
一、保护我免受费尔德太太（我的前非法妻子/过去两个月虽同住一屋但分房而居，实际上并未共同生活）持续不断的、挑衅性和侮辱性的丑闻困扰，这些丑闻旨在玷污我的名誉，并捏造针对我的虚假刑事案件，仿佛我攻击、殴打和侮辱了她；为此目的，她已在副巡官德罗兹多夫的建议下，取得了一份与现实不符的体检证明。
二、将此案移交给另一位侦探处理，因为据我的前非法妻子费尔德太太所言，德罗兹多夫先生在赢得此案以利于她方面存在物质利益关系，即
三、帮助我追回被盗的西装。
四、使我免于副巡官德罗兹多夫的麻烦和威胁，迫使我签署任何玷污我名誉的文件（据费尔德太太所言）并将我打倒。
阁下，我认为有必要告知您，我已通过我的律师申德里科夫先生（Mr. Shendrikoff）采取措施，剥夺她管理我财产的权利。
相信阁下会 favorable 考虑我的申请，
阁下，

您最顺从的仆人，
M. M. 别列佐夫
V. V. 别列佐夫，第85号更夫。

倍利后
